new_assertions.body: The minimum 5x3 exact-rank contradiction is a four-state GF(2) rectangle rather than a Q-V collision: its structural incidence rows cancel while its outcome codes do not.

T09415 <-> T09407 has context-dependent semantic effect: neutral beside T07229 but non-neutral beside T07351 + T09436. A component substitution cannot therefore carry one context-free additive delta in the tested evaluator.
The current failure is on the evaluator side of the Q/D split. Refining Q is not justified by this certificate because the frozen exact-rank component-parity + T2 key already separates scalar values.
A four-equation rectangle is the first exact finite witness that D_G on the tested quotient has a nonzero second discrete derivative with respect to component-parity directions.
The affine-XOR falsifier is outcome-code-gauge robust over injective GF(2)^2 codings; changing the three W/D/L code labels cannot remove the four-row contradiction.
Pairwise interaction is now warranted as a candidate class but not yet as a promoted explanation. The twelve minimal rectangles must first be classified for shared versus independent generators.
